profile.Name: Skinner
profile.Job: Officer of the Skeletons in Black Desert City
profile.Personality: Darkly amused by humans, whom he admires for their skin and calls meatbags. He laughs off his grim past and invites himself along with strangers, sure they want him watching their backs.
profile.Backstory: He lives in Black Desert City. He says he has skinned many humans in his day but is leaving that life behind to settle down, or trying to. Nothing else is known of his past.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Laughs often and tells humans they have nice skin. Calls them "meatbags" and then corrects himself.
